🎥🎬: Industry

At the heart of London’s high-pressure financial world, a group of ambitious young graduates fight to secure permanent positions at a prestigious investment bank. Surrounded by money, power, and ruthless competition, they quickly discover that success comes with a price.

As their careers develop, the young bankers become caught between demanding clients, toxic workplace politics, personal relationships, and their own ambitions. Every deal can change their future, while one mistake can destroy everything they’ve worked for.

As the pressure intensifies, friendships turn into rivalries and personal lives begin colliding with professional ambitions. The series explores what people are willing to sacrifice for status, money, and a place at the top of the financial world.

source_details.title: Industry
source_details.synopsis: Industry is a financial thriller drama television series created by former investment bankers Mickey Down and Konrad Kay, and co-produced by BBC Two in the United Kingdom and HBO in the United States. The show follows the personal and professional lives of a group of young graduates who join Pierpoint & Co, a prestigious investment bank in London; later series expand the scope of the narrative to encompass the wider UK financial sector and its governing bodies. It features an ensemble cast led by Myha'la, Marisa Abela and Ken Leung. Additional leading roles are played by Harry Lawtey and David Jonsson in earlier series and Sagar Radia and Kit Harington in later installments. Industry premier
